Extra: Liu Yue Yue Du (Yue Du (Jie's assistant, the pterodactyl saber-toothed tiger patrolling the sentry, should be enough. "Uncle, I really don't know. Some of the gold tickets in the box were old and the paper was yellowed. Some were obtained in recent years, and each one was brand new and shiny. Unable to help being moved, Su Su weakly groaned and rushed forward, wrapping her arms around one of his front paws and acting cute. "Childong, child, child, child, child..." She muttered over and over again. "In that case, let's leave first! Let sister Yi Yao have a good rest." Lan Qier motioned to everyone. Now, there are three paths in front of him, any of which can achieve his improvement. For the sake of safety, he, the Holy Lord, would not charge into battle, but with his ability to control the weather and activate hurricanes, he could easily add an aerial warrior to his subordinates. All the companions, including the sage, were very cooperative and walked into the kiln without looking at him. Looking at it from a close distance, the blade was black but translucent and rough, as if it were made from nature. There was no manual processing. Although he felt that the old man was a person with a lot of stories, he did not step forward casually to ask. The Yu family always wanted to have a grandson, but they always thought that this was God's retribution to the Yu family. But no one except Grandpa would dare to care about his father's affairs.
